facts: Notebook (feed): After getting their first win in their franchise history the Oaks followed with their second win in the very next game. The Oaks traveled to Detroit where its defense would shine in a 91-78 victory. Adash Stanley shined with 29 points while Austin Rivers facilitated the action with 10 assists while also contributing 12 points a 7 rebounds. AJ Dybansta continued his strong start and little spoken on second round pick , rookie Harry Hayward emergered with 12 points
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C113: The Oaks win again behind a big game behind Adash Stanley. The Oaks 91 - Pistons 78 on the road in Detroit.

Notebook (feed): Watch out now but the Oaks have won three straight games to start the inauguaral season. This time the Oaks traveled to New York to face the Knicks and had another convincing win beting the Knicks 115-93. Austin Reaves and AJ Dybansta lead scoring with 23 points a piece while Adash Stanley flirted with his first triple double. Harry Hayward repeats his strong performance recording a double double.
Oaks — game-result (early-season), C113: The Oaks remain sizzling hot after a winless preseason have now shot out of the gate winning 3 straight. Oaks 115 - Knicks 93 in New York

plan.focus: Oaks fans and neighborhood reaction to the team's 4-0 start
plan.closeQuestion: How will the Oaks' momentum continue to affect the local community?

sources.name: Adash Stanley
sources.quote: The mood among fans is electric. I've felt the excitement building around the Oaks, it's like the whole city is waking up with the team. There's a buzz in the air, and I think people are really looking forward to seeing what they can do this season.

sources.name: Trenton Nawan
sources.quote: I'm still a bit worried about the Oaks, but their 4-0 start is really giving me hope. I checked the scores twice a day all week and was happy every time they won. Maybe they're finally getting their act together.

sources.name: Austin Reaves
sources.quote: To be honest, the neighborhood's been buzzing about the Oaks' 4-0 start. I've seen fans around here getting really excited, and it's infectious. People are talking about it while they're out and about, like when they're unloading groceries or just hanging out on their stoops. The mood feels hungry for more, like they're really craving the next win. I've even noticed some folks around here discussing the team's defense and how well they're working together. It's great to see the community coming together like this behind the team.

approvedQuotes.text: The mood among fans is electric. I've felt the excitement building around the Oaks, it's like the whole city is waking up with the team. There's a buzz in the air, and I think people are really looking forward to seeing what they can do this season.

I'm still a bit worried about the Oaks, but their 4-0 start is really giving me hope. I checked the scores twice a day all week and was happy every time they won. Maybe they're finally getting their act together.

To be honest, the neighborhood's been buzzing about the Oaks' 4-0 start. I've seen fans around here getting really excited, and it's infectious. People are talking about it while they're out and about, like when they're unloading groceries or just hanging out on their stoops. The mood feels hungry for more, like they're really craving the next win. I've even noticed some folks around here discussing the team's defense and how well they're working together. It's great to see the community coming together like this behind the team.
